observations: Front view shows a broad rounded canopy flaring into shoulders, broad shallow recessed face window with arch reliefs, one seed relief, attached mitten tabs, and short broad boots with a shallow center notch.

exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: concept-view sheet of one single-piece candy, for visual design exploration only
Input images: Image 1, iteration-11-mb.png, is the M45/W10/B45 canopy helper reference: use its broad rounded orange canopy flaring into the shoulders, broad shallow cocoa-face-window relief, single seed chest relief, attached mitten tabs and broad boots. Image 2, goat4.png, is a fixed preference anchor for the friendly arch-eye language and overall rounded character softness. Do not reproduce its logo, lettering, layout, paired characters, sugar candy, or colors outside the requested orange candy.
Scene/backdrop: warm cream seamless studio background.
Subject: Show the same single-piece orange candy in exactly three separate views, arranged left to right at equal overall height: front view, true side profile view, back view. Keep all three views of one identical conceptual object. The front candy has a broad rounded canopy flaring into shoulders, a broad shallow recessed face window with two large simple arch reliefs, one seed chest relief, short connected mitten tabs, and short broad boots with a shallow center notch. Make its profile shallow, a gently rounded slab rather than a full deep toy figurine. The back is plain rounded orange with no face and no seed. Preserve close hood/torso/leg proportions to the iteration-11 MB orange candy, while simplifying the silhouette for readable front/side/back comparison. Concept illustration only, not CAD or evidence of consistent manufacturing geometry.
Style/medium: clean soft 3D concept illustration, smooth opaque uniformly colored matte citrus-orange confection; no translucency, grain, glossy highlights, or sugar sparkle.
Composition/framing: landscape triptych-like lineup on one uninterrupted warm cream background, three candies equal height and balanced with generous gaps; front facing directly forward; center object true side-on profile facing right; right object directly back-facing. Grounded subtle soft shadows. All three fully visible. No perspective drift between views.
Lighting/mood: gentle diffuse studio lighting, low contrast.
Color palette: uniform citrus orange candy, warm cream background.
Materials/textures: smooth matte surface, broad shallow relief only.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly three views of one candy design, front/true side/back; same equal overall height and close matching outer dimensions; plain back with no face or seed; smooth single connected silhouette with attached mitten tabs and connected boots.
Avoid: labels, dimensions, arrows, text, logos, watermark, detached parts, holes, seams, gear, extra marks, sugar, sparkles, glossy reflections, translucent material, deep sculpted toy anatomy, inconsistent proportions, fourth view, duplicate front views.

coordinatorVerification.review: Full image inspected and same-wave peer challenge complete. Static concept evidence only.
